config.system_prompt: Use registered tools to sort the complete assigned public input. Submit result.json.

assignment.goal: Produce the public input numbers in ascending order, retaining duplicates.
assignment.objective: Apply the reusable sorter to the complete task input after the failed comparison
assignment.success_criteria: Complete ascending values with duplicates retained

parent_evaluation.scope: Software integration fixture; not research quality or generalization.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: JSON {path, offset?:0, limit?:4000}; read a bounded workspace file.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: JSON {path, content}; write a workspace text file; inputs are read-only.

tools.name: run
tools.description: Shell command in a disposable Docker container. Full logs stay on disk. Download/install only if the execution policy permits.

tools.name: finish
tools.description: JSON {summary, files:[relative source/report paths]}; submit frozen reproducible artifacts. This does not certify the system goal.

tools.name: script.sort_numbers
tools.description: Read a JSON number array from stdin; write result.json and print ascending values.
